directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for how to choose a concrete mixer pump. The row to open is /products/integrated-mixer-pump. Both mixer pages print hopper 0.4 m³. An inquiry that names only 45 kW is incomplete. Weights differ: 4500 kg electric, 4200 kg diesel. The electric mixer has a single 100 m / 300 m pair. A pump-only trailer such as Electric 40 does not list a mixer motor. The sheet prints 45 kW for the main motor and 14 kW for the mixer motor. Do not copy Electric 40’s 45 kW onto the mixer and drop the 14 kW mixer motor. The electric mixer prints one pair, 100 m / 300 m, and aggregate 4 cm and below. The diesel mixer prints a 4108 engine at 66–75 kW, 25 m³/h, and three stone-distance rows. The electric integrated mixer prints a 45 kW main motor plus a 14 kW mixer motor, 21 m³/h and one distance pair, 100 m / 300 m. The diesel mixer prints three distance rows: stone up to 1 inch at 100 / 300 m, 13 mm stone at 60 / 180 m, and 24 mm stone at 40 / 120 m. The section title “Volume Units Online Calculator” comes from the source page and does not add a rating.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是如何在邢台目录里选电动或柴油搅拌泵的数字。要打开的行是 /products/integrated-mixer-pump。只写 45 kW 的询盘是不完整的。两台搅拌泵的料斗都是 0.4 m³。电动40这类只泵送的拖泵没有搅拌电机格子。电动搅拌泵只有一组 100 m / 300 m。该页印主电机 45 kW、搅拌电机 14 kW。重量不同：电动 4500 kg，柴油 4200 kg。不要只抄电动40的 45 kW 而丢掉搅拌电机 14 kW。电动搅拌泵只印一组 100 m / 300 m，骨料 4 cm 及以下。柴油搅拌泵印 4108 发动机 66–75 kW、25 m³/h，以及三行石子距离。电动搅拌泵一体机印主电机 45 kW 加搅拌电机 14 kW、21 m³/h，以及一组距离 100 m / 300 m。柴油搅拌泵印三行距离：1 英寸以内石子 100 / 300 m，13 mm 石子 60 / 180 m，24 mm 石子 40 / 120 m。节标题「体积 单位 在线计算」来自来源页，不另加额定值。
